criteria.description: Workbook opens and exposes identifiable statement identity, transaction, category, reconciliation, and source-traceability sections independent of fixed row positions.
Account identity, period, currency, and opening/statement closing balances match the supplied statement.
Each statement transaction is represented once with the correct date, description, debit/credit direction, amount, and page, independent of row order or candidate-assigned ID.
Transaction IDs are non-empty and unique, and transaction/provenance populations are complete without duplicates.
Every populated transaction net amount, when provided, evaluates to credit minus debit; a separate net formula column is not required.
Opening balance, total credits, total debits, and calculated closing balance are formula-linked and reconcile to the statement balance.
Both manifest-selected transaction changes—a credit and a distinct debit—update the formula-linked reconciliation while preserving unrelated balances.
Category labels are semantically valid and category values agree with the signed transaction table independent of formula use, label wording, or row order.
Each transaction ID links once to the correct statement file/page with a candidate-readable locator; no private locator token is required.
